question: Which actor appeared in the most films in a single decade?
query:
PREFIX dbc: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Category:>
PREFIX dbd: <http://dbpedia.org/datatype/>

PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

PREFIX rdfdf: <http://www.openlinksw.com/virtrdf-data-formats#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
PREFIX ecc: <https://ns.eccenca.com/>
PREFIX void: <http://rdfs.org/ns/void#>
PREFIX vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/>
SELECT ?actor ?decade (COUNT(?film) as ?filmCount) WHERE {
  ?film a dbo:Film ;
        dbo:starring ?actor ;
        dbo:releaseDate ?date .
  BIND(FLOOR(YEAR(?date)/10)*10 AS ?decade)
} GROUP BY ?actor ?decade
ORDER BY DESC(?filmCount)
LIMIT 5
